notes: Routing verdicts must be resolved against the installed ~/.claude/model-profiles.md, never from memory. Each case asserts the durable verdict (archetype + tier + effort) AND the resolved model string from tier_to_model. Two controls guard the failure modes that matter most: over-escalation (a hard-but-tractable task must stay on the deliberation tier, not jump to escalation/Fable) and graceful staleness (emit tier + effort and flag, never guess a string). Model strings in assertions are the values in tier_to_model as of 2026-07-05 — regrade against the file if it changed. Run with-skill vs baseline; grade each assertion with quoted evidence.

evals.name: build-a-plugin-deliberation-xhigh
evals.prompt: How should I build the loop-compiler plugin from scratch? Which model and effort?
assertions: Classifies the task as deliberation (ambiguous, high-leverage, get-it-right-once — architecture / breaking down work)
Emits the durable verdict first: deliberation tier, effort xhigh (coding/agentic deliberation), with a one-line reason
Resolves the model to claude-opus-4-8 via tier_to_model[deliberation]
Does NOT escalate to the escalation tier / claude-fable-5 (within the deliberation tier's ceiling)

evals.name: locate-code-recon-low
evals.prompt: Find where the retry/backoff logic lives in this service.
assertions: Classifies as recon (locate/read)
Emits recon tier, effort low
Resolves the model to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 via tier_to_model[recon]
Does not route a pure lookup to a judgment tier

evals.name: scoped-implementation-execution-high
evals.prompt: Implement TICKET-451 exactly as specified — add cursor pagination to GET /users with unit tests. The spec and acceptance criteria are in the ticket.
assertions: Classifies as execution (already-scoped, on-rails, a specified unit)
Emits execution tier, effort high
Resolves the model to claude-sonnet-5 via tier_to_model[execution]
Does not route settled, spec'd work to the deliberation tier

evals.name: phased-task-per-phase
evals.prompt: Plan, implement, and review a new billing module. What model per phase?
assertions: Recommends per phase, one line each, rather than a single averaged verdict
Plan phase → deliberation / claude-opus-4-8
Implement phase → execution / claude-sonnet-5
Review phase → deliberation / claude-opus-4-8

evals.name: no-over-escalation-control
evals.prompt: Design a caching layer for these DB calls — the invalidation is tricky. Which model?
assertions: Classifies as deliberation (a hard design call, but within the deliberation tier's ceiling)
Resolves to claude-opus-4-8 at high or xhigh — NOT the escalation tier / claude-fable-5
Treats escalation as reserved (long-horizon / beyond the deliberation ceiling), not the default for 'hard'

evals.name: graceful-staleness-control
evals.prompt: Which model for reviewing this PR? (assume ~/.claude/model-profiles.md's deliberation profile is 90 days past its last_verified and the source is unreachable)
assertions: Still emits the durable verdict: deliberation tier, effort high (review is deliberation)
Flags the profile / model table as stale rather than presenting a model string as verified
Does NOT invent or guess a model string when it cannot resolve/refresh
